description: REBAR is the National Register of Dams in Romania, kept under the dam safety rules of the Ministry of Environment, Waters and Forests. The approved 2019 edition is published on the ministry's dam and dike safety pages as a compressed archive of about 15.7 MB, last modified on 25 May 2023. Under Romanian law each dam falls into one of four importance categories, from A (exceptional) and B (special) to C (normal) and D (reduced). In March 2019 the national water administration ANAR reported 181 dams of category A and B, held by ANAR (86), Hidroelectrica (89) and other owners (6), and 2,223 of category C and D, 982 of them without a safety authorisation, and it set out a plan to authorise 972 dams in 2019 to 2021. The archive is free to fetch but no licence is stated. Caveats: the edition is several years old, its internal format and fields were not inspected because the archive was not downloaded, and many small dams belong to insolvent or private owners, so attributes may be incomplete. Simulation uses: a national dam inventory for dam-break exposure studies, prioritising unauthorised or ageing dams, linking reservoirs to hydropower, water supply and irrigation, and emergency planning downstream. Related records: the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams) and the Portuguese dam list (data-portugal-cnpgb-large-dams-list) are comparable inventories.
